records.title: Learning to Look Again: Loss-Gap Supervision for Free-form Crop Routing in Vision-Language Models
records.reason: The abstract presents adaptive visual-token/crop routing with efficiency-oriented token allocation but no quantitative compute reduction in the excerpt; adjacent multimodal inference work needs full-text confirmation.

records.title: MemTrapBench: Benchmarking Cognitive Traps in LLM Memory Use
records.reason: This is inference-time memory-use control, but the abstract reports performance rather than compute/latency effects; possible relation to memory-serving work is uncertain.

records.title: GLaQ: Grounding Latent Queries in Visual Evidence for Multimodal Reasoning
